tool_id_legend: Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool threat ID; Manual = added by the team

threats.name: Denial of service
threats.attack: Flood edge gateway or a Raft leader with requests
threats.mitigation: Rate limits across the external boundary and load balancing
threats.residual_risk: Large DDoS can still saturate links; mitigated with upstream scrubbing

threats.name: Credential theft
assets: Responder accounts and every record they can read
threats.mitigation: Policy engine applies BLP to stolen identities; short-lived tokens; MFA
threats.residual_risk: Real-time phishing, malware or session hijacking, especially of high-clearance accounts
threats.experiment_note: validator credentials are the credential-theft case exercised experimentally; user-credential effects are bounded by the Part D policy engine (policy_conflicts.json)

threats.name: Insider abuse (export / reclassify)
threats.attack: Legitimate user exports or reclassifies data beyond their need
threats.consequences: Classified intelligence leaked and labels lowered to widen access
threats.mitigation: Least privilege via the policy engine; approval before intelligence leaves the Guard's zone
threats.residual_risk: An insider acting within their permissions can only be detected afterwards
threats.experiment_note: insider operating a validator (equivocation) or a Raft node (term inflation, run D)

threats.name: Insider abuse (Guard impersonation)
threats.attack: Insider impersonates the Guard and exploits Incident via a crafted threat flag
threats.consequences: Unauthorised incident modifications, false threat assessments, misleading dispatch
threats.mitigation: Service authentication, input validation, least privilege
threats.residual_risk: Stolen Guard certificates may bypass authentication

threats.name: Malware
assets: Dispatch service and its data store
threats.attack: Compromised host in the operational zone
threats.consequences: Dispatch orders tampered with or blocked; attempt to move into intelligence
threats.mitigation: Domain segmentation blocks lateral movement; every service-to-service request re-authorised
threats.residual_risk: Malware acts with the infected host's legitimate rights until detected
threats.experiment_note: run D: modified code on one Raft node degrades dispatch without breaking safety

threats.name: Supply-chain compromise
threats.attack: Malicious library, container image or update rolled out to every region
threats.consequences: Backdoors in every replica at once
threats.mitigation: Signed builds, pinned and verified dependencies, rolling out one region at a time
threats.residual_risk: Common-mode failure: consensus cannot detect replicas that are all wrong the same way
threats.experiment_note: bft-audit-corruption (pre-signing corruption) shows identical bad input on every replica is committed: the common-mode effect of a backdoored build. bft-key-compromise shows the effect of signing keys exfiltrated by such a build.

threats.name: Datacentre failure
assets: Services and data stores in one region
threats.attack: Power loss, flood or a physical attack on one datacentre
threats.mitigation: Replicas in the other 2 regions keep a majority; the gateway reroutes traffic
threats.residual_risk: With 3 regions BFT may halt; async-replicated data can lose its latest writes

threats.name: Network partition
assets: Consistency of incident and dispatch records across regions
threats.attack: Network links between regions are cut
threats.consequences: Stale or inconsistent information; regions act on different incident states
threats.mitigation: Consensus ensures only the majority side can commit
threats.residual_risk: Minority region loses write access until the partition heals

threats.name: Data corruption
threats.attack: Deliberate tampering via a crafted query, software bug, or disk fault
threats.consequences: Wrong operational decisions; the audit trail can't be trusted
threats.mitigation: Signed audit events on a tamper-evident log, parameterised queries, consensus replication
threats.residual_risk: Corruption that happens before signing or commit is replicated faithfully
